local_review.finding_body: The test project added JTSTestBuilder-support.bin as a test dependency. Its embedded Maven metadata identified a jts-app 1.20.0-SNAPSHOT assembly, and the archive contained 751 org/locationtech/jts class files, including classes supplied by the target jts-core artifact. The tests could therefore execute shadow copies instead of org.locationtech.jts:jts-core:1.20.0, violating §FS-test-contract.2.3's prohibition on shadow classes for library types.
local_review.finding_title: Bundled support JAR shadows the target library
local_review.fix_note: Removed the opaque support archive and file dependency, replaced the optional TestBuilderProxy scenario with version-agnostic jts-core behavior, and added dedicated CoordinateArrays and KMLReader public-API tests that exercise two genuine reflection call sites. Forge finalization refreshed statistics and passed all three native lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validation, and library-statistics generation on a stable rerun.
local_review.review_comment: Checked the single-coordinate file scope, index-validation evidence, metadata format and presence, test package separation, meaningful non-scaffold public-API coverage, version independence, Native Image execution, and the absence of skips, swallowed failures, compatibility overrides, and native build/run flags. After repair, resolved statistics report 2/9 dynamic-access calls covered (22.2222%), above the new-library gate, and the exact Forge finalization command completed successfully with no further publishable-tree changes.
